coverage.why_330: GIS pass 1 keeps Erven that are not non-residential, not RE/ remainders, and under 8000 m² (337 rows). Seven duplicate GIS records share a property_id in SUMMERSET EXT.6, leaving 330 unique erven. OS v1 and the inventory use that unique set. There are no cross-township stand collisions.
